 Models

We recommend ISTA-DASLab first , then Unsloth and other providers, where a compatible model fits.

 
   Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 

 Provider Choices

 ISTA-DASLab · recommended Q2\ 0, IQ2\ XS, IQ3\ XXS, IQ3\ S. Coder: IQ1\ M for coding.

 Other options Swift 1.5, NVFP4, OrcaRouter 

Compare sizes, memory needs and compatibility.

 

 
   Tencent Hy4-Flash 

 Pack Your RAM Graphics card 
 --- --- --- 
 SQ-64 64 GiB 8, 12 or 16 GiB 
 SQ-96 96 GiB 8 or 12 GiB 
 SQ-128 128 GiB 8 or 12 GiB 

The number in the name is the RAM the pack is made for.

Hy4-Flash packs on Hugging Face

 

 
   Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 

 Unsloth: UD-Q4 K XL, UD-Q6 K XL, Q8 0. These are the currently documented packs for this model.

Model guide and compatibility.

 

 
   Inkling 2 Mini 

 Provider Choices 
 --- --- 
 Strata SQ-20 (19.35 GB), SQ-15 (14.35 GB), SQ-10 (10.47 GB) 
 Unsloth UD-Q8\ K\ XL (22.87 GB), UD-Q4\ K\ XL (17.63 GB), UD-Q4\ K\ M (16.61 GB), UD-IQ4\ XS (15.73 GB), UD-Q3\ K\ XL (13.63 GB), UD-IQ3\ XXS (11.66 GB), UD-Q2\ K\ XL (9.14 GB), UD-IQ2\ XXS (8.49 GB), UD-IQ1\ M (8.02 GB), UD-IQ1\ S (7.76 GB) 

SQ-20 is made for a 24 GiB graphics card, SQ-15 for 16 GiB and SQ-10 for 12 GiB. A 4 GiB card is enough to start.

Strata packs on Hugging Face · Unsloth GGUF files

 

 

Not sure what fits? Choose a model for your computer.

 Install

 

 Desktop app

 Download Strata for Windows, Linux or Mac → 

Install the app, choose a model, and start chatting. There is one installer for each system. On first start the app
downloads the engine for your graphics card. Help with the installer.

install.html:
Desktop app

Download Strata for Windows, Linux or Mac →

Install the app, choose a model, and start chatting. There is one installer for each system. On first start the app downloads the engine for your graphics card. Help with the installer.

Files: Strata-0.2.20-windows-x64-setup.exe · Strata-0.2.20-linux-x86_64.AppImage · Strata-0.2.20-macos-arm64.dmg


Chat, files and a live preview in one window.

Terminal app

Prefer the terminal? Install Strata, then run strata launch.

Install commands

Linux / Mac

curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 120 https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases/latest/download/install.sh -o install.sh && sh install.sh

Windows PowerShell

irm -TimeoutSec 120 https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases/latest/download/install.ps1 | iex

On Windows, open a new terminal afterwards. Then:

strata launch

Follow the prompts to download and start a model. Terminal guide.


Watch your model and hardware while it runs.
